reserveReview.rationale: Deloitte's August 31 examination, signed September 28 (letterhead and signature reviewed visually), reports $1,248,950,562 reserves against 1,244,426,424 redeemable USDGO on Solana; Morph liabilities are zero. Reserves comprise $99,693,768 STBXX, $674,279,453 JLTXX, $462,545,429 BUIDL self-custodied on Solana in segregated wallets and $12,431,912 bank cash ($12,181,912 uninsured). Surplus is $4,524,138. No underlying fund-portfolio allocation is inferred.

Anchorage self-custodies the $312,429,373 BUIDL slice in segregated Solana wallets; the report identifies 9yGxs2pSFFBZhJVrwRAgbKHaLQnuHa7BpmCRsHuzG968. The report-time Solana token balance has not been independently replayed by Pharos.
